mistake: One field encodes more than one primitive
signal: A field named price/amount/total/duration/size accepts $12 or 12 USD or 12kg or a bare number with no unit; each consumer parses it differently
why: Rounding and currency errors; impossible to sum or compare across units; locale bugs; lossy parsing at every boundary
fix: Store atomic fields: price_amount as integer minor units or exact decimal plus price_currency as ISO 4217; apply the same rule to duration and measurements; format only at the presentation layer
check: Every monetary column ends in _amount with a sibling _currency; no symbols or unit words in storage; a query can sum per currency without parsing strings

mistake: Money stored as binary floating point
signal: FLOAT or DOUBLE or a plain JS number is used for currency; totals show 0.30000000000000004
why: Binary floats cannot represent most decimal fractions; rounding drift accumulates; reconciliation fails
fix: Use integer minor units (cents) or a decimal type with explicit precision; round only at defined boundaries
check: Schema uses integer or decimal; no float arithmetic on money; a property test covers 0.1 + 0.2

mistake: Timestamps stored without a timezone
signal: A timestamp column has no zone; new Date is formatted locally before storage; behavior changes when the server timezone changes
why: Events shift across DST and deployments; ordering breaks; audits disagree
fix: Store UTC instants; keep a separate IANA timezone for local rules and recurrence; convert at the edges
check: Every instant column is UTC or timestamptz; no local-time string in storage; a DST-boundary test passes

mistake: A measurement stored without its unit
signal: weight/distance/temperature/duration is a bare number and the unit lives in a label or a comment
why: Silent unit confusion; impossible comparisons; conversion bugs
fix: Store value plus unit enum; normalize to one canonical unit at storage; convert for display
check: Every measurement has a sibling unit column or a documented canonical unit; no unit exists only in a display string

mistake: A phone number forced into one unstructured string
signal: The phone field stores spaces dashes extensions or a leading zero inconsistently; country is inferred from another field
why: Impossible to validate dedupe or dial; migration between countries breaks
fix: Store E.164 canonical plus optional country code and extension as separate fields; parse and format at the edges
check: One canonical column; validation rejects impossible lengths; dedupe works across formats

mistake: A postal address stored as one free-text blob
signal: One address field; regexes parse street/city/postcode; a provider rejects valid addresses
why: Cannot validate geocode tax ship or dedupe; formatting varies by user
fix: Store structured components plus a formatted display cache; use a provider for validation
check: Components exist; no regex parsing of a blob; a provider round-trip test passes

mistake: A person name forced into first/last assumptions
signal: Required first_name and last_name; display concatenates them; mononyms or long family names break
why: Excludes valid names; wrong salutations; broken sorting and search
fix: Store a display name plus optional given and family components; never require both; avoid assumptions about order
check: A mononym and a multi-part family name can be saved and displayed; neither component is required

mistake: A derived total stored as an independent source of truth
signal: total is duplicated next to line items; updates touch one but not the other; reconciliation jobs exist
why: Drift; wrong invoices; no way to know which value is correct
fix: Derive from the source rows at read time; or store with an invariant and a single writer; never let two writers own it
check: Recomputed total equals the stored total in a test; only one write path exists

mistake: A boolean used where three states exist
signal: is_verified or is_active or has_consent is false for both no and not asked; migrations add a second flag
why: Cannot distinguish unknown from false; consent and compliance bugs
fix: Use a nullable boolean with documented semantics or an explicit tri-state enum plus a timestamp
check: The schema and API docs state what null means; a not-asked fixture behaves differently from a no fixture

mistake: Age stored instead of date of birth
signal: An age integer goes stale; eligibility rules recompute it
why: Age is wrong after a birthday; eligibility cannot be verified; local formatting is lost
fix: Store birth date; derive age at the point of use with the relevant timezone
check: Age is never persisted; an eligibility test crosses a birthday

mistake: A closed set stored as free text
signal: status/role/type accepts arbitrary strings; code compares literals; typos become new states
why: Invalid states; impossible migrations; silent branch misses
fix: Use an enum or lookup table or constrained string with one canonical list shared by DB API and UI
check: The constraint exists; an unknown value is rejected; one source generates the union type

mistake: Null and missing treated as the same thing
signal: A patch endpoint cannot clear a field; undefined and null both mean no value; defaults apply inconsistently
why: Impossible partial updates; silent overwrites; contract ambiguity
fix: Define three cases explicitly: absent means do not change; null means clear; a value means set; encode them in the schema and tests
check: A PATCH can clear one field without touching another; contract tests cover all three cases

mistake: One query per row in a list
signal: A list endpoint issues N+1 queries; latency grows with page size; logs show repeated identical SQL
why: Slow pages; database load; timeouts at scale
fix: Batch or eager-load relations; select only needed columns; add a query-count test
check: Query count is constant for a fixed page size; a performance test at 100 rows passes

mistake: A screen needs many round trips
signal: One page calls 8-15 endpoints; waterfall latency; loading states multiply
why: Slow perceived performance; partial failures; hard caching
fix: Add an aggregate endpoint or BFF for the screen; batch independent calls; cache stable data
check: The network panel shows a bounded number of requests for first paint

mistake: A breaking API change shipped without a version or transition
signal: A field is renamed or removed or its type changes; old clients fail immediately
why: Outages for every consumer; forced lockstep releases
fix: Make additive changes first; version or negotiate capability; deprecate with a dated window
check: The old contract test still passes during the transition; deprecation is documented

mistake: A secret shipped to the client
signal: An API key or secret appears in JS or a PUBLIC env var or a mobile binary or source
why: Anyone can extract it; full account or data compromise
fix: Keep secrets server-side; use short-lived scoped tokens; scan bundles and history
check: Bundle scan and git history scan are clean; the client only holds public identifiers

mistake: Authorization enforced only by hiding UI
signal: Admin buttons are hidden but the endpoint accepts the request; role checks live only in components
why: Any user with the URL or a crafted request can act; privilege escalation
fix: Enforce authorization on every server route and resource; UI hiding is convenience only
check: A lower-privilege token gets 403 on every protected endpoint; tests exist per role

mistake: Validation exists only in the browser
signal: The server accepts invalid payloads; constraints live in components; direct API calls bypass rules
why: Corrupt data; security holes; inconsistent clients
fix: Validate at the trust boundary and reuse the same schema in the client for UX
check: Invalid payloads are rejected by the API; one shared schema

mistake: The same state stored in two places
signal: User data exists in context and in a store; edits update one; a refresh fixes the UI
why: Divergence; stale UI; impossible debugging
fix: Keep one source of truth; derive the rest; invalidate caches explicitly
check: A single owner exists; a test mutates the source and observes every consumer

mistake: Independent booleans model one async state
signal: isLoading and isError and isEmpty and isSuccess can all be true or all be false
why: Impossible states render; flicker; missed errors
fix: Use one state machine or discriminated union with idle/loading/success/error/empty payloads
check: An exhaustive type switch exists; no impossible combination can be constructed

mistake: Optimistic UI without rollback or reconciliation
signal: An item appears saved then vanishes on refresh; failure leaves the UI ahead of the server
why: Users trust false success; perceived data loss; retries duplicate actions
fix: Snapshot before mutation; roll back on failure; reconcile with the server response; use an idempotency key
check: A forced failure restores the previous UI and shows an error; refresh matches the server

mistake: Derived state copied into state and kept in sync
signal: A useEffect sets state from props; two values should always match; extra render loops
why: Stale values; render loops; bugs that appear only after a prop change
fix: Compute during render or memoize from the source; do not mirror props into state
check: No effect exists only to copy props into state; the derived value has one formula

mistake: Tests assert private implementation instead of behavior
signal: Tests break on refactor with no behavior change; the unit under test is mocked out; call order is asserted
why: False failures; refactoring fear; tests stop protecting users
fix: Test through the public contract; assert observable outcomes; mock only at system boundaries
check: A behavior-preserving refactor keeps the tests green

mistake: A flaky test retried instead of fixed
signal: Intermittent failures; retry counts hide it; rerun to pass
why: Real bugs ignored; trust in CI erodes; slow pipelines
fix: Reproduce and find the shared state or timing or ordering cause; fix it or quarantine with an owner and deadline
check: The test passes repeatedly in isolation and in parallel; no blind retries remain

mistake: A bug fixed without a test that fails first
signal: The fix has no new test; the same bug returns later
why: No proof of fix; regressions; rework
fix: Write the failing test first; watch it fail; fix; watch it pass; keep it
check: The new test fails on the parent commit and passes on the fix

mistake: The symptom is patched without the cause
signal: A retry or catch is added around an unexplained failure; the same error returns in a new place
why: Recurrence; hidden corruption; compounding workarounds
fix: Reproduce; trace to the first invalid state; fix there; then remove the workaround
check: The original reproduction no longer fails; no unexplained catch remains

mistake: A schema change applied without backfill or verification
signal: A new non-null column is added to a populated table; old rows have no value; deploy order breaks
why: Failed migrations; null crashes; downtime
fix: Expand and contract: add nullable; backfill in batches; verify; then enforce; keep it reversible
check: The backfill count matches; a rollback rehearsal passes on a production-sized sample

mistake: Configuration copied across environments
signal: Values are duplicated in several files; prod and staging drift; a secret sits in a plain file
why: Wrong endpoints; leaked secrets; works-in-staging failures
fix: One source per environment; secrets in a manager; validate at boot; document required variables
check: A config diff between environments shows only intended values; boot fails fast on missing keys

mistake: One hard-coded column per supported language
where: db; api; types; orm models; dto interfaces
signal: A translatable field appears as title_en / title_ar / title_fr columns or interface properties; adding a language means a migration plus editing every model DTO and type signature
why: It does not scale: ten more languages is ten more columns on every translatable field; TypeScript interfaces and every layer's types must all be re-edited per language; the language list lives in schema shape instead of data; partial translations become NULL grids; and one missed interface is a silent undefined at runtime
fix: Key translations by locale: a translations table (entity_id; field; locale; value) with locale as a BCP 47 code - or one JSON/JSONB column keyed by locale where per-locale full-text search is not needed; adding a language is a data plus config change and zero schema or type edits. For dialects pick one of the two real models: (a) each dialect is its own locale (ar-EG; ar-SA) resolved with parent-language fallback ar-EG -> ar -> default; (b) a separate dialects table referencing the parent language. Either way the set of languages never appears in column names or interfaces
check: No column or type name matches /_(en|ar|fr|de|es|zh|id)/ in schema or interface definitions; adding a hypothetical new locale touches only seed data and config; fallback chain is expressed in one resolver

mistake: URLs built from non-ASCII values without percent-encoding
where: api; routing; ui links; share urls; server logs
signal: A template or concatenation puts raw localized text into a path or query: '/ar/' + article.title or ?q=<arabic words typed directly>; works in the dev browser and breaks in the wild
why: Unencoded Arabic or spaced text silently corrupts the URL: spaces and & and # alter the route; proxies and servers disagree on encoding so one link resolves differently per hop; the bug hides on the English happy path and surfaces only for exactly the locales you just shipped; the mirror failure - encoding an already-encoded value - breaks links back the other way
fix: Build URLs only through the encoder: per-segment encodeURIComponent for path parts; URLSearchParams for queries (it encodes for you); decode once at the routing boundary not by hand; locale codes stay ASCII in the path; seeds and tests with localized slugs run through the same builders as production
check: No hand-built URL string contains a dynamic localized value; query construction always goes through URLSearchParams; a round-trip test asserts an Arabic title and Arabic query survive encode -> route -> decode byte-equal

mistake: Page-crossing intent kept in transient state instead of a durable store
where: state; auth flows; checkout; deep links; routers
signal: returnTo / pendingAction / plan-id lives in useState or memory-only state and is read back after a redirect; login or a page refresh lands the user on home instead of where they were going
why: Navigation across a redirect - login is the classic: the user tapped buy-plan-42 and may pass through 1 page or 100 - destroys in-memory state; the remembered task vanishes and the user restarts; refresh-sensitivity is the tell; conversion flows and deep links fail exactly when the route is long
fix: Persist the intent durably before leaving: localStorage/sessionStorage or the app's persistence layer holding only non-sensitive flow data (returnTo path; plan id; step marker) - explicitly not tokens or personal data (see secrets-in-client); resolve it on return regardless of pages in between; one store owns the shape so every flow can read it
check: End-to-end: start at /pricing -> bounce through sign-in -> touch other pages -> authenticate -> land back on plan-42; the same survives a hard browser refresh; grep shows no returnTo read solely from in-memory state
